purpose: Replicate the valid negative-epsilon zero-phase anomaly in two fixed opposite acquisition orders, while testing two previously unobserved neighboring targets. Describe finite repeatability without fitting a bypass threshold.

hypothesis_definitions.dcp_continuous: Natural cubic spline evaluated on measured ordinary DCP output dBm, added to measured ordinary source phase.
hypothesis_definitions.raw_continuous: Same spline evaluated on ordinary raw spectral output power converted to dBm; measured ordinary source phase added.
hypothesis_definitions.raw_nominal_zero_bypass: Same raw-power spline; set only its increment to zero at the registered nominal zero-dBm control, without assuming raw power is exactly 0.001 W.
hypothesis_definitions.raw_report_zero_bypass: Same raw-power spline; set its increment to zero wherever ordinary DCP output power equals exactly 0.001 W.

historical_hypothesis_status: All four candidates already failed the complete prior ten-target experiment; new local passes cannot rehabilitate those complete rules or vendor compatibility.

local_spline_polynomial.source: Analytic natural-cubic interpolation of the frozen table, not fitted to new observations.

primary_evaluation.zero_increment_test: Circular difference between measured ordinary output and input phase no greater than 1e-5 degrees.

order_comparisons.interpretation: Agreement supports repeatability only for these five sampled targets under these two orders. Disagreement is evidence of order or state sensitivity, but order, elapsed time, drift and persistent internal state are not causally separated.

input_power_identity.ordinary: Measured ordinary input divided by the zero-control input from the same block must match 10^(registered target dBm/10) within 1e-10 relative. Do not require an ideal absolute input offset.
input_power_identity.repeated_sweep: Measured input power at each registered sweep index divided by the fresh control sweep input at the same index must equal one within the registered relative tolerance.
input_power_identity.source_parameter: The run-time Pwr parameter is independently checked against its registered SI value within 1e-12 relative by the existing normalizer.
input_power_identity.baseline_input: Absolute fresh-control input DCP is compared with the historical same-configuration input DCP using the baseline power relative tolerance of 1e-7.

quick_sweeps.interpretation: All ten sweeps reproduce previously observed scans and are control observations, not new prediction targets. Additional endpoints remain separate.
quick_sweeps.repeated_sweep_gate: Compare every later sweep, including the second zero-control sweep, with the validated first zero control before another call; retain all residuals.

acquisition_rules: Commit this plan, scorer, input preparer and exact helper/source workflow before any SystemVue analysis.

Use the single already-running user SystemVue process. Every call starts with zero open workspaces and opens a separately prepared pristine-derived XML copy; close each result after saving. This does not reset or certify hidden process/cache state.

Both fixed blocks start with a zero-target control. Each zero control must reproduce all historical ordinary and sweep data at the baseline tolerance; the second zero also participates in the across-order comparison at the separately stated tighter ordinary tolerance.

Validate 18 parameter readbacks, registered Decimal source expression, explicit analysis completion, empty diagnostics, raw ordinary V/Z/P, complete DCP sweep, result freshness, execution-source identity, save and closure before the next call.
Stop on a failed acquisition/input-identity gate, either zero historical baseline, or repeated sweep control. Preserve the failure and restore without another analysis.

Historical epsilon differences, across-order ordinary mismatches and new delta prediction failures are scientific results. If acquisition and zero/sweep gates pass, finish the fixed sequence without retries, fitting, tolerance changes or selecting points.
There are exactly ten allowed analysis calls and zero recovery/reserved calls. A failed call consumes its slot; this plan authorizes no replacement run.

Refresh COM metadata after value evaluation, retain all ordered duplicate parameter occurrences, and restore the original workspace with all 245 parameter paths / 247 ordered entries and metadata without extra analysis.
exclusions: No product formula or compatibility-status change is implied by this registration.
The first two delta observations are the only new prediction targets. Their later repeats, six historical replications and all sweeps are controls.

The analytic continuous-spline phase variations at +/-epsilon are smaller than the phase tolerance; the observed zero/nonzero anomaly is much larger. These targets test replication of zero versus nonzero phase, not precise axis discrimination.
The analytic continuous change near +/-delta is about 3.56e-5 degrees, above the phase tolerance, but this does not identify a unique internal coordinate.
Finite targets cannot establish a continuous or symmetric bypass interval, exact threshold, arbitrary-table behavior, swept raw spectra, strong compression, multitone or other frequencies.
Opening independent workspaces in one process does not clear hidden application state; two fixed blocks alone do not isolate a causal order effect.

If acquisition stops early, report only the observed prefix and completed pairs, with missing counts and explicit incomplete status. Agreement in a partial prefix cannot establish complete sequence replication.
